name: flowctl
description: Live graph of what Claude Code is doing and what comes next

autoOpenOverlay.title: Open the overlay
autoOpenOverlay.description: Open the FlowCTL overlay app when a session starts, if it is installed

nudge.title: Ask the agent to declare its plan
nudge.description: Add a short instruction asking the agent to declare and update a plan for work of 3 or more steps (on by default; without it the graph is usually one node)

errorThreshold.title: Errors before red
errorThreshold.description: Consecutive tool errors that turn the current step red

recordEvents.title: Record events
recordEvents.description: Keep the session's events under ~/.flowctl/recordings (for fixtures)
